content:
sam: kicking off the Nimbus-Edge preview with partner. primary asks: NDA telemetry clause, benchmark matrix, and a lightweight reproduce script. who wants to own the initial runbook?
hana: I can take the runbook. will make it minimal and reproducible (container + fixed seed).
diego: thanks. bench matrix should have: seq buckets (<=128, 129-512, >512), p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, peak_mem_mb, power_w. include both batch=1 low-latency and batched throughput profiles.
tara: add cold-start vs warmed-up KV cache tests. and note quant profiles to test: fp16, int8, int4.
sam: timeline idea: runbook v0 by Wed EOD, send NDA appendix + runbook to partner Thu, tests Fri-Mon, sync Tue. reasonable?
hana: tight but doable. legalbot, can you confirm minimal telemetry language for NDA (partner wants sample schema)?
legalbot: Legal: allowed telemetry fields (privacy-safe) = run_id, model_name, variant, seq_len, tokens_generated, lat_p50_ms, lat_p95_ms, mem_peak_mb, gpu_util_pct, env_tag. No raw payloads or PII. Include retention and destruction clause.
diego: for debugging we can request aggregated kernel histograms and hashed stack traces only (no symbols). put that in the debug appendix.
tara: CI creds: opsbot, can you create ephemeral creds for partner with scoped S3 read/write and bench-queue access?
opsbot: system: created ephemeral creds template. TTL default 8 hours. ops will provision per partner slot.
hana: sample run snippet I'll add to runbook:
```
./bench.sh --image redwood/nimbus:eap --model redwood-edge-v2 --batch 1 --seq 256 --out report.json
```
report.json must contain summary buckets and a telemetry_summary object.
sam: embargo/marketing: partner asked about a marketplace listing + joint blog. legal says embargo until mutual sign-off. add checklist in runbook.
hana: action items:
- hana: runbook v0 + sample container + CLI (due Wed EOD)
- diego: bench matrix CSV + quant profiles (due Wed)
- tara: lab slots + access calendar + invite (due Thu)
- legalbot: telemetry appendix + retention clause (due Wed)
- opsbot: ephemeral creds template + provisioning doc (due Wed)
opsbot: system: created private repo `redwood/nimbus-edge-preview` and invited hana,diego,tara. URL: https://git.internal/redwood/nimbus-edge-preview
hana: got it, pushing README and template tonight. will ping when v0 is up.
sam: thanks all, keeping this thread as the canonical EAP coordination log. :white_check_mark:
